name: cache-keeper
description: Shows a prompt-cache countdown, context size, rate-limit usage and session cost above the prompt, with a handoff-and-compact button.

cacheWindowMinutes.title: Cache window (minutes)
cacheWindowMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity after which the prompt cache is assumed to have gone cold. There is no documented API for the real server-side TTL, so this is a configurable estimate, not a measurement.

warnBeforeMinutes.title: Warn before (minutes)
warnBeforeMinutes.description: How many minutes before the estimated cache-cold point to send one notification.
